name: Bologna
pointBasis: Immutable WUP 2025 queue point copied unchanged in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment.
registryBasis: The official Comune di Bologna SIT ArcGIS CATASTO service returned a parcel polygon and safe cadastral identity fields in a bounded anonymous query around the unchanged WUP point. This evidences public cadastral map coverage, not citywide completeness.
blocker: Public parcel geometry is verified, but runtime remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.

source.operator: Comune di Bologna - Sistema Informativo Territoriale (SIT)
source.custodianScope: Municipal cadastral map service published by the Comune di Bologna SIT; the service metadata identifies a Bologna cadastral parcel layer.
source.crs: Native layer EPSG:23032 / ED50 UTM zone 32N; query output requested as EPSG:4326 GeoJSON with coordinate order [longitude, latitude].

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official service metadata, layer schema inspection, and one bounded anonymous point-intersection query around the immutable WUP point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: One safe Bologna parcel polygon returned, containing/intersecting the queried point vicinity.

technicalBlocker: Native response exposes FID and cadastral components PARTKEY, COMUNE, FOGLIO and MAPPALE. The retained canonical identity is the source composite PARTKEY; FID is an internal source OID and is not used as the sample identity.
remainingUncertainty: The bounded query does not establish citywide completeness, parcel freshness, or universal service behavior. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.

queries.query: Bologna official cadastral map parcel viewer Comune Bologna catasto particelle
queries.result: First-party discovery located the Comune di Bologna SIT CATASTO ArcGIS MapServer and its parcel layer.

queries.query: Bologna mappa particelle catastali ufficiale Comune di Bologna catasto
queries.result: La ricerca in italiano ha trovato il servizio ufficiale CATASTO del SIT del Comune di Bologna e il layer comunale delle particelle catastali.

requests.assessment: Official Comune di Bologna SIT MapServer identified the CATASTO service, Bologna extent, native EPSG:23032, and parcel child layer 0.
Parcel layer metadata identified Polygon geometry, native EPSG:23032, safe fields FID, PARTKEY, COMUNE, FOGLIO and MAPPALE, and GeoJSON query support.

requests.method: GET; anonymous; TLS verification enabled; point intersection at transformed WUP point; outFields restricted to safe cadastral fields; outSR=4326; f=geojson
requests.assessment: Returned one Bologna polygon with PARTKEY=A944_ 187  296, COMUNE=A944, FOGLIO=187 and MAPPALE=296; geometry was returned as GeoJSON in EPSG:4326.

inspectedConfiguration.responseSchemaObserved: ArcGIS FeatureCollection/GeoJSON with Polygon geometry and safe cadastral attributes
inspectedConfiguration.nativeIdentityMapping: PARTKEY; source composite combining municipality and cadastral sheet/parcel components; FID is an internal OID and not the retained canonical identity.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Source geometry is verified at a bounded location, but adapter qualification is reserved for the serial reviewer.
